verdicts.reason: A keeps the original two-column structure with one clean left edge for the text, but it doesn't really adapt to the square: the right edge of the circle nearly touches the text column, there are uneven gaps between the headline, body copy and badges, and there is dead space at the top and bottom. B stacks the content, but nothing lines up: GLACIER, the headline/body, the badges and the CTA each start at a different x-position, forming a ragged staircase. The logo floats alone at top-right with an empty block below it, and the image cluster in the top-left makes the layout lopsided.
